name: HiringCafe Job Search
description: Job search MCP server over millions of postings from employers' own career sites, with filters for seniority, pay, company size, funding stage and more. No sign-in needed.

skills.name: Search Job Postings
skills.description: Search live job postings by keyword, location, seniority, salary, company headcount, funding stage and investors.

skills.name: Get Job Details
skills.description: Get the full posting for one job, with description, requirements, compensation and the application link.

skills.name: Read Saved Searches
skills.description: With a connected HiringCafe account, read the user's saved searches and parsed resume summary to match jobs.
